kebab_example: aliyun agentloop run-pipeline --agent-space my-agent-space --pipeline-name my-pipeline --from-time 1735660800 --to-time 1735747200 --biz-output inline=false dataset=true --region cn-hangzhou
name: RunPipeline

parameters.help_en: The name of the AgentSpace where the pipeline is located
parameters.help_zh: AgentSpace 名称，定位流水线所在的 AgentSpace
parameters.name: agent_space

parameters.help_en: The name of the pipeline to be triggered
parameters.name: pipeline_name

parameters.help_en: The start time of the data processing window in UNIX seconds. This parameter is required for SQL pipelines and time window-based WorkItem sources. It can be omitted for checkpoint-based WorkItem sources such as Dataset and Logstore Pull
parameters.help_zh: 数据处理窗口起始，Unix 秒。SQL Pipeline 和时间窗口型 WorkItem Source 必填；Dataset、Logstore Pull 等 checkpoint 型 WorkItem Source 可省略
parameters.name: from_time

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to write data to the target dataset. Default value: true
fields.help_zh: 是否写入目标 Dataset，默认 true
fields.name: dataset

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to return inline results in the response. Default value: false
fields.help_zh: 是否在响应中返回内联结果，默认 false
fields.name: inline

parameters.help_en: The output control settings. SQL pipelines support overriding these settings. WorkItem pipelines use the saved sink configurations and must keep the default values
parameters.help_zh: 输出控制。SQL Pipeline 支持覆盖；WorkItem Pipeline 固定使用已保存的 Sink 配置，必须保持默认值
parameters.name: output

parameters.help_en: The end time of the data processing window in UNIX seconds. It must be provided together with fromTime and must be greater than fromTime. This parameter can be omitted for checkpoint-based WorkItem sources
parameters.help_zh: 数据处理窗口结束，Unix 秒。与 fromTime 同时提供且必须大于 fromTime；checkpoint 型 WorkItem Source 可省略
parameters.name: to_time

requestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate the request during troubleshooting
requestId.description_zh: 请求 Id，用于排查问题时定位本次请求

requestId.title_zh: 请求 Id，用于排查问题时定位本次请求

runId.title_en: 本次触发创建的 Run Id
runId.title_zh: 本次触发创建的 Run Id

status.description_en: The current status of the run. The status is typically Pending after the run is enqueued
